retained_observation.boundary: This establishes a descriptive annular line-of-sight pattern in the selected sample, not flat circular rotation, identical star speeds, resonance, or an alternative-gravity mechanism.
retained_observation.label: RESOLVED_OUTER_TO_INNER_LINE_OF_SIGHT_VELOCITY_SPAN_PATTERN
retained_observation.observed_pattern: Across 204 quality galaxies, the median outer-to-inner stellar velocity-span ratio is 1.356 and the H-alpha median is 1.231. Only 14.7 percent of stellar ratios and 40.2 percent of H-alpha ratios lie within 20 percent of unity.
retained_observation.reuse_rule: Do not retune on the 204 opened Item 14 responses or open the 80 sealed Item 14 confirmations. Test causal timescale variables on fresh identities or a materially independent response after freezing the Item 15 grammar.

tested_family.boundary: Static image masks do not measure temporal pattern speed, corotation, Lindblad radii, long-lived resonance, deprojected circular speed, or a gravitational field equation. Those materially different representations remain open.
tested_family.observed_pattern: Nested selection worsens stellar held-out MSE by 2.58 percent with paired p=0.827. The same fold-selected cells worsen H-alpha MSE by 0.10 percent without candidate reselection. Five of six broad strata regress, and the only positive stratum gain is negligible.
tested_family.scope: The rejection covers the frozen rotation/reflection-invariant GZ3D spiral and bar mask amplitudes, phase relationships, pitch/twist summaries, radial mode persistence, harmonic coupling, entropy suppression, and declared nonlinear combinations for resolved annular line-of-sight velocity-span ratios.

why_item_complete: The exact fresh-identity test passed every source, quality, boundary, and accounting gate; scored all 262,144 frozen cells with nested held-out selection; transferred the selected cells to H-alpha without reselection; and returned a scoped rejection.
